concept.hr: Većina drži jednu stranu živom; paran broj čvorova, svjedok i rascjep mozga
concept.en: A majority keeps one side alive; even counts, witnesses and split-brain

summary.hr: Razdvoji grozd od 2 do 5 čvorova i dodaj svjedoka: uslugu smije pokrenuti samo strana s više od pola glasova. Bez kvoruma piše svaka strana.
summary.en: Partition a cluster of 2–5 nodes and add a witness: only a side with more than half the votes may run the service. Ignore quorum and every side writes.

concept.hr: Dva čvora i svjedok na dijeljenoj mapi: jedan pada, drugi ima 2 od 3 glasa
concept.en: Two nodes and a file share witness: one fails, the other has 2 of 3 votes

concept.hr: Pali čvorovi gube glas, svjedok glasa uz paran broj: grozd radi do zadnjeg čvora
concept.en: Failed nodes lose their votes, the witness votes on even counts: down to 1 node

concept.hr: Zaglavljeni čvor nije mrtav: ugasi ga prije nego što mu preseliš uslugu
concept.en: A hung node is not dead: power it off before its service moves
